resources.string: Rotation lives in the system settings. Turn on \"Modify system settings\" for this app, then come back.
Keep the lock when apps ask to rotate
Fullscreen videos and some apps can still rotate the screen while it\'s locked. Allow \"Display over other apps\" and the lock wins: an invisible pixel holds the orientation while it\'s locked.
Keeping it locked even when apps ask to rotate
Add any of these to Quick Settings to switch without opening the app.
